"scope":
			var key := str(action.get("key",""));var value=action.get("value")
			if key=="single":scope.running=true;scope.single=true;scope.armed=true
			elif key=="running":scope.running=bool(value);scope.armed=false;scope.single=false
			elif key=="coupling" and str(value) in ["AC","DC"]:scope.coupling=value
			elif key=="edge" and str(value) in ["Rising","Falling"]:scope.edge=value
			elif key in ["trigger","timebase","scale","attenuation","source"]:
				var bounds := {"trigger":[-60,60],"timebase":[.001,.05],"scale":[.01,20],"attenuation":[1,10],"source":[0,1]}
				if not is_finite(float(value)):return "Invalid scope setting"
				scope[key]=clampf(float(value),bounds[key][0],bounds[key][1])
			else:return "Unknown scope control"
